Ammonia is a tweak loader for macOS. Lisa needs it.

This installs the official release from [GitHub](https://github.com/MachLiberation/Ammonia/releases), unchanged.

Restart after installing. Tweaks won't load until you do.

### Good to know

Ammonia adds the `-arm64e_preview_abi` boot arg and turns off library validation so apps can load tweaks. That makes your Mac less locked down, so only install tweaks you trust. Any boot args you already had are kept.

Removing Ammonia deletes it and its daemon, but leaves the boot arg and library validation as they are.
